verses.en: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
verses.sm: Tariu le tupu, ona latou suesue lea i le fale tusi na tuuina ai oloa i Papelonia.

verses.en: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
verses.sm: Ona maua lea i Akemeta i le ‘olo o i le itu malo o Metai le tusi taai, ua faapea foi ona tusia i ona totonu le upu e faamanatu ai,

verses.en: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
verses.sm: O le tausaga muamua o Kuresa le tupu ua poloai atu ai Kuresa le tupu i le fale o le Atua i Ierusalema, Ia faia le fale, o le mea na latou fai ai taulaga, ma ia atiina ae ona faavae; e onogafulu o kupita lona maualuga, e onogafulu o kupita lona lautele;

verses.en: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:
verses.sm: e tolu atu maa tetele, ma le atu laau fou; ma ia avatua le totogi ai le fale o le tupu;

verses.en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.
verses.sm: O mea foi o auro ma ario o le fale o le Atua na avea e Nepukanesa ai le malumalu o i Ierusalema, na na au mai foi i Papelonia, ia toe avatua, ma ia tuu atui le malumalu o i Ierusalema, e taitasi le mea ma tuu i le mea e tuu ai i le fale o le Atua.

verses.en: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
verses.sm: O lenei, Tatenai e, le alii e pule i ona tala atu o le vaitafe; Setara-posenai e, ma e pule faatasi ma oulua, o tagata o Afareseka o i ona tala atu o le vaitafe, ia taumamao outou ma lena mea;

verses.en: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
verses.sm: tuu pea ia le galuega o lena fale o le Atua; ia faia lena fale o le Atua i lona tulafale e le alii e pule i tagata o Iuta, ma toeaina o Iuta.

verses.en: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu foi i mea tou te faia i toeaina o Iuta e fai ai lena fale o le Atua, ia vave foi ona avatua i na tagata oloa a le tupu, o taulaga foi ia i ona tala atu o le vaitafe, e totogi ai le galuega ina ia le tuua e i latou le galuega.

verses.en: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
verses.sm: O mea foi e tatau ia i latou, o povi taanoa, ma mamoe poa, ma tamai mamoe, e fai ma taulaga mu i le Atua o le lagi, o saito, o masima, o uaina, ma suãuu, e pei ona fai mai ai o faitaulaga o i Ierusalema, ia tuuina atu ai ia te i latou i lea aso ma lea aso,

verses.en: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
verses.sm: aua neʻi faatamala ; Io ina ia latou faitaulaga a“ i mea manogi i le Atua o le lagi, ma tatalo ia ola le tupu ma ona atalii.

verses.en: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
verses.sm: Ua ou poloai atu foi, ai se tagata na te liua lenei upu, ia toina se laau ai lona fale, ia siitia foi o ia, ma ia faamauina i ona luga; ia fai foi lona fale ma faatáfuna ona o lea mea.

verses.en: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
verses.sm: O le Atua foi o le na faatumauina lona suafa i lea mea, ia lafo i lalo e ia atoa uma tupu ma nun, o e faaloaloa o latou lima e liliu ma faataumaoi lenei fale o le Atua o i Ierusalema. O au o Tariu ua ou poloai atu; ia matua faia lava.

verses.en: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
verses.sm: Ona vave faia lea e Tatenai o le alii e pule i ona tala mai o le vaitafe, o Setara-posenai, ma e pule faatasi ma i laua e pei o le feau mai le tupu o Tariu.

verses.en: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.sm: Ona fai lea e toeaina o luta o le fale, ua manuia foi ona o le perofeta ane a Hakai le perofeta, ma Sakaria le atalii o Ito. Sa latou faia le fale ma faaumaina ai, e tusa ma le poloaiga a le Atua o Isaraelu, ma le poloaiga a Kuresa, ma Tariu, ma Aretaseta le tupu o Peresia.

verses.en: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.sm: Ua faaumaina lenei fale i le aso tolu o le masina o Atara, o le ono lea o tausaga o le nofoaiga a le tupu o Taru.

verses.en: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,
verses.sm: Ua faia le faaulufalega o lenei fale o le Atua ma le fiafia e le fanauga a Isaraelu, o faitaulaga, ma sa Levi, ma tagata uma o le tafeaga,

verses.en: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.sm: ua latou fai taulaga foi i le faaulufalega o lenei fale o le Atua, o povi poa e selau, o mamoe poa e lua selau, ma tamai mamoe e fa selau; ma ‘oti poa e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala ona o Isaraelu uma e sefulu ma le lua ia, e tusa ma le faitau o itu aiga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.sm: Ua latou tofia faitaulaga i o latou vasega, ma sa Levi i o latou vasega, e fai ai le galuega a le Atua o i lerusalema, e pei ona tusia i le tusi a Mose.

verses.en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.sm: Ua faia e tagata o le tafeaga le paseka i le aso e sefulu ma le fa o le uluai masina.

verses.en: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.sm: Aua sa faamamāina faatasi le au faitaulaga ma sa Levi, ua mami i latou uma, ua latou fasi foi le paseka mo tagata uma o le tafeaga, ma o latou uso o. le au faitaulaga, atoa ma i latou lava.

verses.en: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
verses.sm: Ua aai ai foi le fanauga a Isaraelu e na foi mai i le tafeaga, ma i latou uma e na vavae mai ia te i latou ai le leaga o tagata ese o i le nuu, e sailiatuaiile AL11le AtuaoIsaraelu;

verses.en: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.sm: ma latou faia le tausamiga o areto e le faafefeteina i aso e fitu ma le fiafia; aua sa faafiafiaina i latou e le ALII, na ia liliu foi le loto o le tupu o Asuria ia te i Jatou e faamalolosi ai o latou lima i le faiga o le fale o le Atua, o le
